victim_caste.quote: a meeting of a Patidar Community was convened

offence_category.reason: Final conviction is culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charged sections and the 304 Part I and 324 convictions are accurately captured.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances noted besides ends of justice.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Gopal convicted under ss.148, 302, 323/149; Shanker Lal and Nand Lal under ss.148, 302/149, 323; Chhotelal and Dinesh under ss.148, 302/149, 323/149; sentences not detailed

trial_court_outcome.reason: Mostly accurate, but the value garbles section groupings slightly (302/149 for Chhotelal etc.). Substantially fine; minor discrepancies.

high_court_outcome.quote: found guilty for commission of offence under Section 304 Part-I IPC and awarded rigorous imprisonment for 10 years
high_court_outcome.reason: Accurately reflects the High Court outcome.
